description: Java class MidiFramer that processes MIDI byte streams, parsing and converting them into discrete MIDI messages, handling running status, System Exclusive messages, and real-time messages.

classes.name: MidiFramer
classes.description: A class extending MidiReceiver that parses incoming MIDI byte streams into messages, handling SysEx, running status, and real-time messages.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Overrides MidiReceiver's onSend method to process incoming MIDI data bytes, parse messages, handle SysEx and real-time messages, and send complete messages to the receiver.
